jobs.title: Senior Project Manager (m/w/d) / Print, Digital & Bewegtbild
jobs.description:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

Was macht ein Senior Project Manager (m/w/d) bei WPP Production?

Als Senior Project Manager Digital (m/w/d) in Hamburg oder Berlin gestaltest du moderne Marketing-Asset-Produktionen für nationale und globale Kund*innen – effizient, skalierbar und zukunftssicher. Du übernimmst die End-to-End-Verantwortung für integrierte Kampagnen über Print, Digital, Social, DOOH und Bewegtbild. Gemeinsam mit lokalen und internationalen Teams hältst du Qualität, Timing und Budget in Balance und treibst den sinnvollen Einsatz von KI und neuen Technologien aktiv voran.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Ganzheitliche Projektsteuerung: Eigenverantwortliche End-to-End-Führung eines Portfolios mittlerer bis großer Produktionen – von der Briefingschärfung und Machbarkeitsprüfung über Scoping und Ressourcenplanung bis zum finalen Rollout
  • Stakeholder- & Schnittstellen-Management: Zentrale Ansprechperson für Kund:innen und Agenturen; souveräne Koordination von internen Teams sowie lokalen, Nearshore- und Offshore-Produktionseinheiten
  • Kaufmännische Projektverantwortung: Präzise Kalkulation, Budgetüberwachung und Soll-Ist-Kostenanalysen über den gesamten Projektzyklus sowie enge Zuarbeit für das Finance-Team
  • Qualitätssicherung & technische Freigaben: Fachliche Steuerung der Qualitätskontrollen für alle Assets (Druck-PDFs, Display-Banner, Social Media, DOOH, Bewegtbild) gemäß technischer Spezifikationen
  • Risikomanagement & Workflow-Optimierung: Proaktives Lösen von Engpässen, vorausschauende Risikominimierung sowie kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen und KI-gestützten Tools

Das bringst du mit

  • Fundierte Senior-Erfahrung: Mindestens 5 Jahre Praxis im Projekt- oder Produktionsmanagement (Agentur- oder Produktionsumfeld) mit nachweisbarem Track Record in der termin- und budgetgerechten Steuerung komplexer Kampagnen

jobs.title: Product Manager II - Financial Crime Operations
jobs.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance 

 Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.
 
 The team 
 Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.
  
 Kraken's Compliance Operations teams, including the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU), investigations and enhanced due diligence, are the front line of how Kraken detects and responds to financial crime. The systems they run on sit within Core Services Product, alongside the engineering teams who build them. That covers alert ingestion, case management, investigator tooling and a growing set of automation and AI tools.
 
 This role owns the product for that investigation platform. That means how an alert is created, enriched, grouped and suppressed. How it becomes a case. How an investigator reaches and documents a decision. And how every step is evidenced to a regulator or auditor. You'll start with the FIU, where the workflows are most complex and the audit bar is highest, then extend the platform across Compliance Operations.
  
 The opportunity 
 Own the investigation-platform roadmap end to end. Sequence it and defend it, and re-sequence it when a regulator or the RCO raises a P0.

 Define "done" before build starts. Write phased deliverables and acceptance criteria that Compliance signs off, and hold the line when scope moves.

 Get requirements in before engineering starts. Build the intake between Compliance policy, monitoring rules and case management so that changes don't reach investigators before their workflows are ready.

 Understand the process before building. Reconcile policy and SOPs against what investigators actually do and what the system actually does. Know the difference between a process fix and a technical one, and say which requests are in scope for engineering.

 Understand the pipeline well enough to challenge it: ingestion, profile and transaction resolution, suppression and grouping logic, and reconciliation between vendor output and case management. Be able to walk an auditor through it with live examples.

 Make auditability a first-class requirement: audit trail, data lineage, evidence retention, reviewer attribution, change-management controls, and validation of filtering and suppression logic.

 Ship automation and AI into regulated workflows with controls that hold up in Compliance, IT and privacy audits. That means human-in-the-loop design, explainability and ongoing monitoring.

 Run the operating rhythm: a shared forum with engineering and adjacent product managers, a regular stakeholder update, and one delivery status that everyone reads the same way.

  
 What you bring 
 4+ years of product management, including 2+ years on financial-crime systems such as transaction monitoring, investigations, case management, KYC/EDD or sanctions screening.

 Working knowledge of how an AML programme is examined, including the questions regulators, internal audit and model validation ask about monitoring, filing and control systems.

 The technical fluency to go deep on data flows and system design with engineers, and to spot when a design won't meet the requirement.

 A track record of shipping internal tools or operational platforms that measurably changed how an operations team works.

 Clear, concise writing, from PRDs and phase plans to audit walkthroughs and executive updates.

 The judgement to tell a senior stakeholder a timeline isn't realistic because the requirements aren't written yet, and to keep the relationship intact.

  
  
 Nice to haves 
 Direct FIU experience, such as alert disposition, SAR/STR filing or leading investigators.

 Crypto or digital-asset experience, such as blockchain analytics, wallet-level transaction analysis or focal vs counterparty logic.

 Experience shipping AI or ML into a regulated investigative workflow, including the control design.

 Build-vs-buy and vendor evaluation for monitoring or case-management tooling.

 Experience with programmes that span jurisdictions (UK, EU/MiCA, US).

 Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

 We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Doctolib Connect team in Amsterdam.
 Doctolib Connect is a secure medical communication app designed for healthcare professionals. Today, Doctolib Connect is the largest medical network in Europe. You'll work closely with a talented team to develop user-friendly products that meet market demands, such as tele-expertise or patient referral flows.
 
 What you'll do 
 As a Senior Product Manager on the Doctolib Connect team, you will drive the development of products that strengthen care cooperation among healthcare professionals. Working at the heart of a cross-functional team, you will shape products that serve over 900,000 users across our network, combining a user-centric and data-driven approach with a focus on network effects and long-term impact. Success in this role means growing Doctolib Connect's network, launching products that achieve product-market fit, and delivering measurable value for both our users and the business.
 Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:
 
 Contributing to our product strategy to grow Doctolib Connect , identifying opportunities that strengthen the network and deliver user and business value

 Defining, shipping, and iterating on new products and features by analysing data, conducting user interviews, researching competitors, and leveraging cross-functional insights

 Working closely with cross-functional teams including sales, marketing, support, and company leadership to ensure solutions serve users and meet business needs across target markets

jobs.title: Agent Product Manager
jobs.description:
Competencies 
 You're part product manager, part builder, part engagement lead. You take a messy customer process and re-design for Pi to handle autonomously. You're technical enough to own the configuration yourself: you understand APIs, data flows, retrieval and authentication, and you use AI coding tools to extend what Pi does, with the judgement to know when a change makes sense and the discipline to test it before it ships. You're as comfortable running a requirements workshop with a commercial leadership team as you are debugging why Pi made a decision, and you care deeply about the outcome Pi delivers.
 More specifically, the people who do this well bring:
 You turn customer requirements into precise Pi configuration: instructions, data, guardrails and escalation paths

 You configure and fix things yourself, using AI tools to handle technical changes without waiting on engineering

 You test like it matters: you design the scenarios and simulations that define what good looks like, and you don't launch until Pi meets them

 You run engagements with energy and structure, keeping customers, timelines and stakeholders moving toward go-live

 You own the number: adoption, time saved, revenue retained, whatever the customer deployed Pi to deliver

 You are Product's voice from the field, turning what you see across customers into clear, prioritised feedback that makes Pi better

 You likely have at least 3 to 4 years of experience, and you're technically competent enough to configure, test and debug an AI agent yourself. That might come from:
 A recent role as a forward-deployed product manager or forward-deployed engineer

 Product management on a technical product

 Founding a company, or building hands-on with AI in a way you can show us

 More than your title, we care about curiosity, rigour and a bias to action.
 Trajectory 
 Pi is Planhat's customer agent: a single agent that can be configured to take on processes across the commercial lifecycle, from onboarding and adoption to renewal and expansion. 
 Agent Product Managers are the people who make Pi real for each customer. You join once the customer has signed, work directly with them to shape how Pi is configured for their processes, and extend it to new processes and teams. You run a small portfolio of customers, own a specialty commercial area and help shape how the team works. 
 Everything you learn feeds straight back to Product, so Pi gets better for every customer, and you work closely with Sales, CS, Product and Engineering so no context or momentum is lost.
 Imagine:
 Taking Pi live on a customer's renewals process in weeks, from the first requirements session through testing to launch

 Setting Pi up to run account management for a customer's long-tail accounts: monitoring health, preparing renewals and handling the outreach no human team has time for

 Reviewing a week of Pi's work for a customer, spotting where it falls short, and shipping the fix the same afternoon

 Extending Pi from one process to the next for the same customer, until it runs across their commercial lifecycle

 Turning a pattern you've seen across five customers into a capability Product builds into Pi for everyone

 In this role you will: 
 Run Pi deployments for a portfolio of customers, from kickoff to live and beyond

 Agree success metrics with each customer and report on the impact

 Help customer leaders decide where Pi goes next

 Train the teams who work alongside Pi so they use it and trust it

 Build the playbooks and templates that make each deployment faster

 Definition of Success 
 Success in this role is measured by what Pi delivers for your customers, and how much better it gets because of you.
 Your customers hit the targets they deployed Pi for

 Their leaders come back to you for what's next, and Pi expands into new processes and teams

 Product ships improvements to Pi that started with you

 
 Compensation
 The OTE salary range for this position is $130,000 - $150,000 per year. Please note that actual salaries will vary based on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. Please also note the range listed is just one component of the company’s total rewards package for exempt employees. Other rewards may include performance bonuses, long term incentives, a generous PTO policy, and other benefits.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Vinted Go
jobs.description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

Vinted Go is the delivery arm of Vinted, focused on developing products and solutions for seamless shipping and delivery across Europe and the US. Our delivery network includes more than 30,000 pick-up and drop-off (PUDO), thousands of delivery drivers and cutting-edge sorting tech. Our product portfolio spans mobile apps, IoT devices, and autonomous robots. We operate right where high-scale software meets physical hardware, storefront partner operations, and complex logistics.

In this high-visibility, high-impact role, you’ll join a dedicated cross-functional product team working in close partnership with Engineering, Product Design, Decision Science, Operations, and external partners, you’ll drive the product roadmap, lead discovery, and build scalable solutions that power physical operations across our network.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Drive the product strategy and roadmap for your ownership area.
  • Lead the end-to-end discovery, design, development, and launch of products.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners, including product, business, operations, and external teams.
  • Enable the team to create fast impact, prioritising working software, rapid feedback loops, and live experiments over heavy PRDs.

About you 

  • Several years of proven product management experience in a fast-paced environment, working effectively with cross-functional teams in a matrix organisation.
  • Strong ownership mindset: a self-starter comfortable driving alignment amid ambiguity, making decisions with incomplete data, and taking calculated risks.
  • Data-driven and analytical: comfortable applying a combination of qualitative and quantitative methods to define success metrics and act on insights.
  • Adaptable, resilient, and comfortable operating in environments with shifting priorities.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a pragmatic, hands-on approach to getting things done.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly to both technical and operational stakeholders.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 working days of holiday
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Comprehensive Medical Insurance
  • Group Life and Income Protection Insurance
  • A matched pension scheme up to a set limit
  • Access to a discounted gym membership plan
  • Lunch benefit per working day
  • Frequent team-building events
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted

Position description 

 As Senior Product Manager for code quality, you’ll decide how 7 million developers find problems in their code as AI writes more of it. The gap is large: 96% of developers don’t fully trust AI-generated code, yet only 48% always check it before committing (Sonar State of Code, 2026). With the engineers who build our analyzers, you’ll shape what SonarQube detects across Cloud, Server and IDE, and how teams verify code written by agents. 

 

 
 The team: 

 
 You will join the Code Quality product team, part of Sonar's Product Management group. Each Code Quality PM works with dedicated engineering squads and partners closely with UX, marketing and sales. We value collaboration, kindness and continuous improvement, and we base decisions on data and customer evidence. 

 What will you own: 

 
 
 The strategy and roadmap to develop our language ecosystems, from market research and customer discovery to shipped rules and analyzers.

 
 Decisions on which new languages Sonar should support, and where we should not compete. 

 
 New AI capabilities: how our analysis fits into the workflows of AI coding agents, and how quality gates apply to AI-generated code. 

 
 Day-to-day trade-offs with analyzer engineers, such as rule precision versus noise, and analysis speed. 

 
 Regular contact with developers and customers through calls, our community forum and conferences, and turning what you learn into roadmap decisions. 

 

 What you will do 
 
 You’ll enjoy this role if you care about well-crafted software and like owning a topic end to end.

 

 
 Product vision and roadmap: research, clarify, and prioritize opportunities, and keep the roadmap effective

 
 Customer interaction: engage with users on the product forum, support them, and turn their feedback into opportunities

 
 Domain expertise: develop a deep understanding of code quality and how to help developers write more reliable, maintainable software

 
 Cross-team work: collaborate with other PMs on cross-product features, and align with engineering and UX from problem definition through development

 Experience and qualifications 
 
 Must-haves 

 
 5+ years in technical roles, ideally including hands-on software development. 

 
 3+ years as a product manager on a technical or B2B software product, owning discovery, strategy and roadmap rather than only the backlog, preferably in an agile environment. 

 
 Hands-on use of AI coding assistants or agents in your own work, and an informed view of how they are changing software development. 

 
 Proven ability to lead a topic autonomously from start to finish, making pragmatic decisions amid change, complexity and uncertainty. 

 
 Fluent written and spoken English. 

 Nice to have 

 
 Solid understanding of code quality in at least one programming language or ecosystem. 

 
 Technical understanding of how code scanning and static analysis tools work. 

 
 Experience in developer tools, or contributions to open-source tooling such as linters, compilers or IDE plugins. 

 
 Experience speaking or writing for developer audiences. 

 

 If you meet most of the must-haves and this work interests you, we encourage you to apply even if your background doesn’t match every point. 

 Benefits of Working with Sonar: 

 We encourage usage of our robust time-off allocations with 27 PTO days for our employees based out of the Geneva region, plus additional days based on seniority and circumstances.

 We contribute 60% of the total cost for your pension; 13.5% to 15.5% of your base salary for savings; 2% for risk.

 Generous discretionary Company Growth Bonus, paid annually.

We offer award-winning regulatory intelligence and AI solutions to help organizations protect people and products. With over 35 years of experience and a global presence, we empower our customers with innovative compliance solutions.

 Join us and make an impact!

 As an Implementation Project Manager at 3E, you’ll lead larger, more complex customer implementations where successful delivery requires multiple products, technical contributors, workstreams, dependencies, and stakeholders to operate against one coordinated plan.

You’ll establish success and acceptance criteria, own the integrated project plan, manage risk and change, coordinate specialists and technical teams, and give both customers and 3E leadership a clear, data-backed view of project health.

 Identify opportunities to improve implementation processes, delivery predictability, time-to-value, and the overall customer experience.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Fitness is the one industry where customers actually enjoy using the product. Help us tell that story well. At Sport Alliance, we're looking for someone who can bring clarity to our product portfolio and help us connect the right products with the right customers across different markets.

 Every one of our products needs a clear reason to exist, a clear customer and a clear story. You’ll work alongside Product from the earliest sizing and segmentation conversations through to launch and adoption, so what we build is what the market wants and what Sales can sell.

 As our Senior Product Marketing Manager, you'll shape product positioning, packaging, and go-to-market strategies, turning complex offerings into clear value propositions that Sales can confidently bring to customers. 

 Your position in our team 
 

 
 Tell one clear story per product. Own product positioning and messaging across our brands, creating clear, differentiated value propositions tailored to customer segments and markets.

 
 Help decide what gets built, and why. Build market sizing and segmentation, and work with product so what we build meets customer needs and drives growth.

 
 Shape packaging. Shape product packaging, working closely with Product, Pricing and Finance.

 
 Launch things properly. Own go-to-market for key launches, from sizing and planning through to enablement. Join early, before the build, so the commercial view shapes the product from day one. Build a repeatable launch process that makes every launch smoother than the last.

 
 Show what worked. Track adoption and conversion of new features and modules against the uplift we forecast. Where we hit it, find ways to do more. Where we didn't, learn why and feed it back into strategy. Your measures: product attachment, expansion MRR, win rate by segment and average deal value by product.

 
 Stay close to customers and competitors. Talk to customers directly, run buyer research and win/loss, and own our ICPs. Build competitive intelligence as a living asset, with an AI agent doing the heavy lifting.

 
 Equip Sales to win. Own the sales-facing narrative and build the tools: pitch narratives, battlecards, ROI calculators, case studies. Then see which ones get used and which ones move deals. Enable the sales team to tell the right story, and track whether they get used.

 
 Build it, don't brief it. Use AI to speed up research and prototype pages, calculators and demos yourself. Hand the best ones to the agency or web team to scale.

 Your profile 

 
 6+ years of experience in Product Marketing, Product Management or a commercially focused product role within B2B SaaS.

 
 Proven experience owning product positioning, messaging and go-to-market initiatives, including shaping packaging or pricing recommendations, with the ability to explain the commercial reasoning behind your decisions.

 
 Hands-on experience bringing products to market with defined targets and measurable outcomes, and a clear understanding of what worked and what didn't.

 
 Ability to build and communicate strong commercial value cases or ROI models.

 
 A hands-on approach to creating assets such as prototypes, pages and calculators: you build, test and improve rather than simply brief others.

 
 Practical experience using AI tools for research and content creation, with an understanding of their strengths and limitations.

 
 Confidence working with commercial data, including pipeline, win rates and product attachment, using tools such as HubSpot or Salesforce.

 
 Fluent German and English (C1 level).

 Your salary 
 

 We offer a salary range of EUR 70,000 – EUR 80,000 per year.

 Final compensation will be based on experience, skills, and overall fit for the role.

 Your benefits with us

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager, Energy & Defence
jobs.description:
Finance Deserves Better
 Finance teams at fast-growing companies run global, real-time businesses on a patchwork of legacy ERPs and point solutions. Every new entity, project or tool adds another system to stitch together and another hire to keep the numbers reconciled.
 Light gives them a way out. We build the finance solution that lets finance teams have it all, through three parts that work as one:
 Our ledger records every transaction across every entity in real time, so the numbers hold up from day one.

 Our apps adapt Light to how each business runs, from procurement to billing to reporting.

 Our agents operate the repetitive work that used to need another hire, so finance teams spend their time on the decisions that matter.

 Today we run the finance function for companies like Lovable, Legora and Keyshot, with backing from Atomico, Balderton, Seedcamp, Cherry and Entrée. Now we’re taking Light into specific industries, with the ambition of becoming the operating layer each one runs on. Energy and defence sit among our priority sectors.
 
 The Role
 We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager to go deep on energy and defence and work out how Light wins there.
 Energy developers, operators and service businesses share a lot with defence technology and service suppliers. Both run on project and contract economics, both report across several entities, and both face long, multi-stakeholder buying cycles where auditability and approvals carry real weight. Your job is to understand these buyers better than anyone at Light, turn what you learn into positioning and proof our sales team can use, and build the playbook we follow to scale our go-to-market across both sectors.
 You’ll sit in our product marketing team and work side by side with the Sales Managers who cover these sectors, with support from demand generation, field marketing and product.
 
 What You’ll Be Doing
 Interviewing customers, prospects and specialist partners to learn how energy and defence businesses buy, what makes them change and where their finance workflows break.

 Mapping the market with Sales: which segments we go after first, which we test, and which we leave for later.

 Turning what you learn into positioning, messaging and competitive arguments that hold up in front of a project director or a CFO.

 Building the sales kit, from customer stories and demo narratives to objection handling and one-pagers, so our reps speak each sector’s language.

 Training sales reps and SDRs on the buyers, procurement cycles, contract structures and regulatory context of each segment, and joining customer calls to hear what lands.

 Bringing the sectors’ requirements back to Product, from project and contract economics to cash visibility, evidence trails and integrations with operational systems, and separating the needs that recur from the one-off requests.

 Giving demand generation and field marketing the insight, content and angles they need for sector campaigns and events, and tracking what turns into pipeline.

 Writing down what works, so the next sector we enter starts from a playbook rather than a blank page.

 
 What We Think* You’ll Need
 Product marketing experience at a B2B SaaS company, with a track record of taking a product or segment from insight to launch to sales adoption.

 A habit of talking to customers, and the judgement to turn interviews into clear positioning.

 Experience in energy, defence, infrastructure, industrials or another complex B2B sector helps. Curiosity and the speed to earn credibility with technical buyers matter more.

 Strong writing, from a sharp one-pager to a customer story people want to share.

 Comfort working with Sales every day, and a feel for what helps a rep win a long, complex deal.

 An analytical streak. You can read funnel data, spot where deals stall and test why.

 Daily use of AI for research, writing and analysis, with the discipline to check what it tells you.

 A can-do, empathetic and collaborative spirit. No brilliant jerks here, please.

 *If the core of the role sounds compelling but you don’t tick every box, we’d still love for you to reach out and convince us you’re the right person.
 
 The Good Stuff
 🏢 A five-day, in-office culture with a high-density team in London.
💸 A competitive salary and potential stock options.
🏝 25 days of annual leave plus UK public holidays.
🥳 Regular socials and two company offsites a year. The last 2 were in Tuscany & Provence!
🌍 Travel to Copenhagen, Munich, New York, Paris and wherever energy and defence customers, partners and industry events take us.
🚀 The chance to define how Light wins in two sectors from their first deals.
 Light is an equal opportunity employer.
 
 The Famous Last Words

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing solutions for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on. 
 
 As Senior Product Marketing Manager you will build a deep understanding of the end-to-end solutions (hardware and software) across all of Underwater Security (our OptiBarrier and OptiArray product lines and our software platform), and of the markets and customers they serve. You turn that understanding into clear positioning, compelling value propositions and go-to-market plans that help our sales teams win.
 
 Optics11 is in its scale-up phase, and product marketing in Underwater Security is starting from a basic level. You will build the product marketing function from the ground up: you set up the frameworks, processes and tools it needs, while delivering tangible commercial results along the way. You start as an individual contributor, with the opportunity to grow a small product marketing team over time.
 
 You will be part of the Product team in Underwater Security and work closely with our solutions Product Managers for hardware and software, Sales, Business Development, Marketing, Application Engineering, Customer Projects and R&D teams.
 
 No two weeks will look the same. You might analyze a competitor’s new seabed monitoring system, sharpen the value proposition for an anti-submarine warfare (ASW) tender, work on the launch of a new software release, train the sales team on a new product narrative, or help prepare a customer demo for a tradeshow such as UDT or Euronaval. You will own how our products are positioned, launched and sold in the market, support pricing decisions, and make sure your market insights support Optics11 product decision making.
 
 Within your first 6–12 months, you will have evolved the foundations of product marketing in Underwater Security: clearly defined target segments and buyer personas, a positioning and messaging framework per product line, a competitive intelligence baseline, a repeatable launch process and a first sales enablement toolkit. Your work will sharpen our market focus, improve our win rate and help Optics11 scale its solutions commercially in demanding, high-stakes markets. 
 
 Responsibilities:
 Build the product marketing function by setting up the frameworks, processes, templates and tools for positioning, launches, competitive intelligence, sales enablement and product marketing analytics, tracking pipeline contribution and win rates, and scaling them as the organization grows.

jobs.title: Product Lead (m/w/d)

Product Lead (m/w/d) - Lern-Ökosysteme für Unternehmen, Bildungszentren und Verbände 
 80–100 % · Zürich · Festanstellung · per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung
 Über MaxBrain 
 MaxBrain AG wurde 2016 in der Schweiz gegründet und ist ein führender Anbieter für digitale Lernlösungen mit aktuell 12 Mitarbeitenden. Mit einer innovativen Kombination aus Learning Management System (LMS) und Learning Experience Plattform (LXP) übersetzt MaxBrain Lernstrategien in ganzheitliche, digitale Lern-Ökosysteme für Unternehmen, Bildungszentren und Verbände.
 Renommierte Bildungsinstitutionen sowie zukunftsorientierte Unternehmen vertrauen auf die Expertise von MaxBrain, darunter Bildungspartner wie Digicomp, WEKA und Talentus, führende Berufsverbände wie SwissAccounting, Electrosuisse und die OdA beider Basel sowie Marktführer wie Zweifel Chips & Snacks, InfoGuard, BLT Basellandschaft Transport und Baumann Koelliker und viele mehr.
 

 Worum es geht 
 Lernen ist für uns kein Pflichtprogramm. Lernen ist ein Motor für Entwicklung, Performance und Kultur.
 Unsere Vision: MaxBrain wird die People-Development-Plattform für mittelständische Unternehmen. Das Fundament steht: geschäftskritische Lern-Ökosysteme für Bildungsinstitute und Verbände. Darauf bauen wir auf. Künftig bildet MaxBrain nicht nur Lernmassnahmen ab, sondern auch die Prozesse, die bestimmen, wer was, wann und weshalb lernt: Skill Management, Performance Management, Compliance, Onboarding und Karrierepfade. KI ist dabei kein Zusatzmodul, sondern unterstützt in jedem Schritt: beim Finden passender Inhalte, beim Abgleich von Skills und bei Lernwegen, die sich automatisch anpassen.

Du entwickelst sie konsequent vom Markt, von Kundenproblemen und vom wirtschaftlichen Nutzen her. Du setzt Prioritäten, reduzierst Komplexität und schaffst Klarheit.
 Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Entwicklungsteam in Kroatien und dem Team in Zürich zusammen, berichtest direkt an den CEO und hast die Perspektive, Teil der Geschäftsleitung zu werden.

 Produktvision und -strategie: Du entwickelst die Vision von MaxBrain als People-Development-Plattform weiter und übersetzt sie in eine klare Produktstrategie. Du legst fest, welche Probleme wir für welche Kunden lösen und welche nicht.

Integrationen in HR-Systeme wie Personio, Abacus oder Microsoft machen die Plattform zur Infrastruktur statt zur Insel.

 KI als Hebel: Du nutzt KI-Werkzeuge intensiv für Research, Spezifikation, Prototyping und Design. So deckst du mit einem schlanken Setup viel ab und entscheidest schneller und besser.

 Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest Hand in Hand mit Engineering, Sales und Customer Success. Du schaffst Alignment über Prioritäten und Nutzen.

 Dein Profil 
 Du hast einen nachweisbaren Track Record im L&D-, EdTech- oder HR-Tech-Umfeld.

 Du bringst 5–7 Jahre Erfahrung im Product Management, Product Design oder einer vergleichbaren Produktrolle mit, idealerweise mit einem komplexen B2B-SaaS-Produkt.

 Du hast eine Produktstrategie entwickelt und umgesetzt. Du hast Produkte oder grössere Features von der Discovery bis zur erfolgreichen Einführung geführt. 

 Du kennst Corporate Learning und People Development. Erfahrung mit LMS, Skill- und Performance-Management oder angrenzenden HR-Produkten ist ein grosses Plus.

 Du denkst strategisch und arbeitest hands-on. Du sprichst gerne direkt mit Nutzern, strukturierst komplexe Probleme und arbeitest selbstständig mit Design- und Prototyping-Tools wie Figma.

 Du denkst in Nutzerproblemen statt in Features. Du wägst Kundenwünsche, Marktchancen, Unternehmensziele und Aufwand gegeneinander ab.

 Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch (C2) und Englisch (mind. C1). Französisch, Italienisch oder Kroatisch sind ein Plus.

 Eine Kultur, die lebt, was wir verkaufen: Wir lernen selbst jeden Tag dazu, teilen Wissen offen und nehmen «Make Learning Matter» auch intern ernst.

jobs.title: Head of Product (H/F)
jobs.description:
Ta mission 🎯 

 

 En tant que Head of Product, tu seras amené·e à guider nos clients (Decathlon, Carrefour, SeLoger, Chanel, Deezer, ...) dans leur transformation Produit et l’amélioration de leurs pratiques, soit en immersion au sein des équipes, soit en tant que Coach ou expert Produit. 

 

 Tu seras également le Manager / la Manageuse d'une équipe chez Thiga pour faire d'eux·elles les meilleur·e·s consultant·e·s & Product People possibles ! 

 

 Tu auras pour mission de : 

 - coacher et accompagner des équipes Produit chez ton client pour les faire gagner en maturité Product Management par la mise en place et la diffusion de bonnes pratiques ; 

 - évaluer la maturité produit d’équipes en place et proposer un plan d’action approprié pour optimiser l’organisation et les processus Produit ; 

 - cadrer et lancer un nouveau produit ou challenger et améliorer un produit existant ; 

 - déployer une vision long terme et coordonner la réalisation concrète de la roadmap ; 

 - encadrer ton équipe de Thiguys·girls avec du temps dédié pour permettre à tout Thiguy·girl d’être dans les meilleures conditions pour son développement professionnel et s’assurer de son épanouissement. 

 Compétences métier 🖇 

 Tu as déjà managé et, après une période d’onboarding, tu accompagneras et encadreras ton équipe de consultant·e·s Thiga.

 Tu établis la stratégie et la vision produit.

 Tu définis la roadmap et planifies les futures versions de ton produit avec une stratégie user-centric, orientée problèmes et outcomes.

 Tu maîtrises le Design Thinking et le Lean Startup.

 Tu sais interpréter les KPI mesurant la performance de ton produit et en déduire l’impact sur les utilisateurs. 

 Tu peux accompagner ton équipe dans la définition de ses OKR.

 Tu collabores avec des Product Designers pour concevoir l’expérience utilisateur et créer les interfaces web ou mobile, tu sais préparer des tests utilisateurs.

 Tu connais et utilises des techniques de priorisations (Rice, MoSCow, Kano…).

 Tu es à l'aise sur le Product Delivery et l'ensemble des rituels Agiles.

 Compétences relationnelles 🎙 

 La communication : tu donnes de la visibilité et t’exprimes de manière synthétique en étant également à l’écoute des autres.

 La diplomatie : tu sais défendre tes idées et tes convictions & gérer les relations entre différentes parties prenantes. Tu sais faire preuve d’assertivité.

 La curiosité : tu t’informes des nouveautés et des meilleures pratiques en Product Management.

 L’humilité : tu sais te remettre en question et apprendre de tes erreurs pour mieux évoluer.

 Shameless : tu parles français couramment tout en ayant un bon niveau d’anglais même si quand tu prononces beer, bird, bear ou beard ça se termine en quiproquo 🍺 🐥 🐻 🧔🏻

 Expériences 📇 

 Idéalement, tu as minimum 6 ans d’expérience dans une structure Produit (avec de la Product Discovery comme du Product Delivery).

 Tu as déjà managé (en direct) et / ou tu justifies d’au moins une expérience de Product Leader (Head of Product, Lead PM,...) dans ton parcours.

 Nous offrons 🎊 

 Un On-boarding d'une semaine pour rencontrer tes collègues dont 3 jours de formation pour bien démarrer.

 Du confort avec deux jours de télétravail par semaine (selon le client) complétés par un accès à un catalogue de matériels, ainsi qu’un Macbook Air ou un PC selon ta préférence.

 Du fun avec des Thigapéros, des Squad-building et un séminaire (en prêtant attention à notre empreinte carbone).

 De l’apprentissage avec minimum 5 jours de formations à l’année et beaucoup de contenus pour te faire monter en compétences, notamment un programme de formation dédié aux Product Leaders avec des modules permettant de maîtriser toutes les facettes de ce rôle (coaching, OKR, organisation Produit, stratégie Produit).

 Et pleins d’autres avantages comme une carte Swile, le remboursement de ton abonnement de transport à 50%/forfait mobilité durable, etc.

 Les étapes 🎢 

 Un pré-entretien téléphonique avec un membre de l’équipe recrutement.

 On te rencontre en personne ou par visio avec un·e dirigeant·e de l'équipe Thiga (Associé, Partner ou Principal) pour valider tes acquis.

 Une étude de cas avec deux consultant·e·s du niveau Manager ou Principal afin de confirmer ce que tu sais mettre en pratique.

 Un dernier échange pour apprécier l’entente mutuelle 🤝

 Thiga accueille toutes les personnes compétentes et passionnées et s'engage en faveur de la diversité culturelle, l'égalité de genre et l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés — au contraire nous considérons la diversité comme une grande richesse !

jobs.title: Junior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Introductie 
 Ben jij analytisch sterk, commercieel ingesteld en heb je affiniteit met techniek en productmanagement? Weet jij marktontwikkelingen te vertalen naar kansen voor producten en diensten? En krijg jij energie van het optimaliseren van een productportfolio en het succesvol introduceren van nieuwe producten?
 Bij FAAC Technologies zoeken we een Junior Product Manager die verantwoordelijk wordt voor de positionering en ontwikkeling van ons productportfolio. In deze rol vorm je de verbindende schakel tussen Sales, Marketing, Techniek en de internationale productmanagementteams van FAAC Group. Door marktontwikkelingen te volgen en klantbehoeften te analyseren, zorg je ervoor dat onze producten aansluiten op de behoeften van de markt en de strategische doelstellingen van de organisatie.
 We zoeken iemand die aan het begin van zijn of haar carrière staat en zich verder wil ontwikkelen binnen productmanagement. Of je nu net bent afgestudeerd en klaar bent voor een eerste uitdaging, of al circa 1 tot 3 jaar werkervaring hebt opgedaan: enthousiasme, analytisch vermogen, commerciële interesse en de motivatie om je te ontwikkelen vinden we minstens zo belangrijk als ruime werkervaring.
 In deze veelzijdige hybride functie komen marktinzichten, commerciële analyses en technische kennis samen om onze producten en diensten continu te verbeteren. Je krijgt de ruimte om je kennis en ervaring verder uit te bouwen en te groeien in de rol. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de Manager Techniek.
 
 Wat ga je doen / Taken en verantwoordelijkheden 
 Als Product Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor de positionering, ontwikkeling en optimalisatie van het productportfolio van FAAC Technologies. Marktbehoeften en productontwikkelingen vertaal je naar concrete verbeteringen. Daarnaast zorg je ervoor dat productinformatie, prijzen en communicatie actueel en consistent blijven.
 Analyseren van marktontwikkelingen en klantbehoeften om deze te vertalen naar het productaanbod

 Uitvoeren van prijsanalyses en afstemmen van de prijspositionering met internationale productafdelingen

 Volgen van productontwikkelingen en vertalen van relevante innovaties naar kansen voor de organisatie

 Afstemmen van productintroducties en de lancering van nieuwe diensten met betrokken teams binnen FAAC Group

 Begeleiden van processen rondom productintroducties en het uitfaseren van producten

 Analyseren en optimaliseren van het bestaande productportfolio

 Coördineren van technische producttrainingen en in kaart brengen van de opleidingsbehoefte binnen de organisatie

 Leveren van input voor productcommunicatie, waaronder online communicatie en marketingmateriaal

 Bewaken van de kwaliteit, volledigheid en consistentie van productinformatie

 Beheren en actualiseren van artikellijsten, prijslijsten en productdocumentatie

 Zorgen voor toegankelijke en actuele productinformatie voor interne afdelingen en andere betrokkenen

 Samenwerken met Sales, Marketing, Techniek, internationale productmanagementteams en klanten

 Naleven van de geldende HSE-richtlijnen en bijdragen aan een veilige werkomgeving
 

 Wat bieden wij 
 Bij FAAC Technologies werk je in een stabiele, internationaal opererende en technisch gedreven organisatie met een informele werksfeer en veel ruimte voor zelfstandigheid.
 Een salaris tussen € 4.359,45 en € 6.198,54 bruto per maand , afhankelijk van ervaring

 40 vrije dagen (27 vakantiedagen + 13 ADV-dagen)

 Een goede pensioenregeling via PME, het pensioenfonds voor de Metalektro 

 Een veelzijdige hybride functie op het snijvlak van techniek, commercie en productmanagement

 De mogelijkheid om bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling en positionering van een internationaal productportfolio

 Intensieve samenwerking met verschillende disciplines en internationale teams

 Een professionele werkomgeving met ruimte voor eigen initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling
 

 Over FAAC Technologie 
 FAAC Technologies, onderdeel van de wereldwijd opererende FAAC Group , is dé specialist in toegangsautomatisering. Van automatische deuren en poorten tot slagbomen en parkeersystemen – wij leveren innovatieve en veilige oplossingen. Bij FAAC werk je in een informele, technische en dynamische omgeving waar samenwerking en klantgerichtheid centraal staan.
 De FAAC Group omvat 32 bedrijven in 24 landen , met 18 fabrieken in 15 landen en 3 business units . Dankzij deze internationale schaal ontwikkelen en implementeren wij wereldwijd oplossingen voor personen- en voertuigenverkeer, met een sterke focus op kwaliteit, veiligheid en duurzaamheid.
 
 
 Wie ben jij 
 HBO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in een commerciële, technische of bedrijfskundige richting.

 Aan het begin van de carrière, met de ambitie om verder te groeien binnen productmanagement.

 Een starter of circa 1 tot 3 jaar relevante werkervaring, bijvoorbeeld in productmanagement, productmarketing, sales of een vergelijkbare functie.

 Affiniteit met technische producten en commerciële vraagst

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
The challenge 
An entrepreneur chasing an unpaid invoice in Lagos. A shop owner confirming a shipment in Guangzhou. A consultant navigating a bank's phone menu in London. For a growing share of Talk360's 6 million+ users, a call is how they get paid, keep a client or close a deal.
 These business customers choose us because we're cheaper than carrier and roaming rates, reach mobile, landline and company numbers, need no contract, and use one balance for every country. Today we serve them with a consumer app. Tomorrow we want to be the obvious way small businesses call the world.
 
 We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own and scale the Calling for Work product proposition from 1 to 100. There's no mature roadmap to inherit: you'll write it, test it with customers and scale what works, with our Product & Tech team, to deliver a step change in segment growth.
 
 What you’ll do 
 Own the product proposition: Set the vision, strategy, roadmap and targets for Calling for Work, and be responsible for its user growth and retention.

 Shape the business proposition: Define what Talk360's business offer is and how it's priced, together with our commercial teams.

 Learn from customers continuously: Use interviews, surveys, support tickets and app store reviews to turn pains into a ranked opportunity roadmap.

 Experiment fast: Ship small bets, A/B test the journeys that matter, observe real world behaviour and turn results into roadmap decisions.

 Lead delivery: Work in an agile Product & Tech team; keep scope tight, priorities clear and releases flowing.

 AI-native execution: Use AI across discovery, specs, analysis and prototyping, and help shape how the team builds with AI.

 Partner across the business: Work with Revenue, Marketing, Support and Data on go-to-market, acquisition, retention and the metrics that show we're winning.

 
 
 The Team 
 You'll join a lean Product & Engineering team where product, design, mobile, web, backend, VoIP and QA work closely together. No silos, no layers: turn a customer insight on Monday into a live experiment by Friday.
 
 What you’ll bring 
 5+ years in product management, including owning a product line or new proposition end to end.

 A track record of scaling a product from early traction, with commercial results to show.

 Hands-on experience with B2B, SMB or prosumer products; telecoms is a plus.

 Strong discovery skills: customer interviews, research synthesis and jobs-to-be-done thinking.

 Experimentation fluency: A/B testing, product analytics (Mixpanel or similar) and data analysis and data-driven decision making.

 Experience optimising MAU, ARPU, LTV, retention and conversion, with the business acumen to make strategic and tactical calls.

 Experience leading agile, cross-functional mobile product teams, with the technical depth to discuss trade-offs with engineers.

 Active, daily use of AI across your product workflow: research, analysis, specs and prototyping.

 
Who you are 
 Growth mindset: You're energised by building a playbook that doesn't exist yet.

 Ambitious and pragmatic: You aim for 100 but ship the smallest thing that proves the next step.

 Owner: You act without waiting for permission and own outcomes, not output.

 Customer-obsessed: You'd rather talk to five customers than debate one assumption.

 Clear communicator: You align engineers, leadership and partners around one simple story.

 Comfortable with ambiguity: You make good calls on imperfect data and kill what isn't working, even your own ideas.

 You're based in or moving to The Netherlands and can be in our office three days a week.

 
Recruitment process 
 First call: A short intro call with our recruiter.

 Hiring manager interview: A deep dive into your experience with our Head of Product.

 Case study: Present a practical Calling for Work challenge to the team at our office.

 Meet the CEO. 

 Reference check 

 Offer 

 
 What You Get 
 Competitive compensation 
 77,000 - 90,000 euros per year all-in gross

 Learning and growth 
 €1,500 annual personal development budget, plus access to company-wide training sessions to keep learning and evolving. 

 Time to recharge 
 25 vacation days 

 Option to swap two public holidays per year for days that better reflect your culture or beliefs 

 Recharge Fridays, unlocked when team targets are met (we’ll tell you more during the interview) 

 Work from anywhere 
 As a global and diverse team, we encourage you to work from another city or country for up to 2 weeks per year, gain fresh perspectives and spark new ideas. 

 A team you’ll actually want to be part of 
 Weekly team lunch every Thursday 

 Regular team moments and outings 

 An international and diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond 

 Set up for success 
 Company laptop and all the tools you need to do your best work 

 Monthly phone allowance and commuting allowance

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
Product Owner 
 Amsterdam - Lijkt het jou interessant om als product owner aan een applicatie voor miljoenen gebruikers te werken waarbij je grote invloed hebt op de architectuur en technische ontwikkelingen? Lees dan snel verder! 
 Wat ga je doen? 
 Als Product Owner bij Reclamefolder.nl ben je de operationele rechterhand van de Product Manager en zorg je ervoor dat het productteam altijd weet wat er gebouwd moet worden, waarom dat belangrijk is en hoe succes wordt gemeten. Je vertaalt inzichten uit klantgesprekken, data en gebruikersonderzoek naar concrete en uitvoerbare features. Daarmee lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan de doorontwikkeling van een platform dat 872000 unieke bezoekers per maand ontvangt. Zonder jouw regie ontstaat onduidelijkheid over prioriteiten, scope en requirements, waardoor de ontwikkeling van het platform vertraagt. Dit doe je onder andere door: 
 Productkeuzes en inzichten uit klantgesprekken, data en gebruikersonderzoek te vertalen naar goed uitgewerkte features met heldere user stories, acceptatiecriteria, edge cases en meetpunten. 

 Refinements voor te bereiden, de backlog actueel en overzichtelijk te houden en ervoor te zorgen dat web-, iOS-, Android- en backendteams altijd vooruit kunnen werken.

jobs.title: Senior Product Owner
jobs.description:
De backlog is niet het probleem. De vraag achter de vraag wel. 
 Een volle backlog is geen visie. Een roadmap is geen strategie. En een sprint review is geen impact. Als Senior Product Owner weet je dat. Je hebt de complexe omgevingen gezien, de politieke stakeholders, de systemen met twintig jaar technische schuld. Je bent niet op zoek naar een functie waarbij je uren vult. Je zoekt een omgeving die jou scherp houdt.
 
 De uitdaging 
 Bij LINKIT werk je als Senior Product Owner op opdracht bij organisaties waar de complexiteit hoog is: ministeries, grote corporates, data-intensieve omgevingen waar één verkeerde prioritering maanden vertraging oplevert. Jij bent de schakel tussen strategie en levering, tussen de directie die richting wil en het team dat die richting uitvoerbaar moet maken.
 
 Dat betekent in de praktijk dat je eindverantwoordelijk bent voor backlog, prioritering en roadmap, en dat je die verantwoordelijkheid neemt ook als stakeholders tegengestelde belangen hebben. Je vertaalt abstracte organisatiedoelen naar concrete productkeuzes. Je stuurt op waarde én op compliance, op snelheid én op continuïteit. En je laat teams en producten structureel beter achter dan je ze aantrof.
 
 Je gaat in dienst bij LINKIT en gaat op opdracht bij klanten in sectoren als overheid, finance en logistiek. De techniek, omgeving en prioriteiten van de omgevingen wisselen; de verwachting dat jij eigenaarschap pakt, niet.
 
 Jouw plek 
 Bij LINKIT werken we in squads, dit zijn onze expertise teams. Elke twee weken is er de clubdag: alle Explorers komen op vrijdag terug naar het hoofdkantoor in De Meern voor kennissessies, verdieping en verbinding. Tot 10% van je werktijd gaat naar leren en groeien, niet als bijzaak maar als onderdeel van hoe LINKIT werkt.
 
 Wat we vragen 
 Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Product Owner in complexe IT-omgevingen.

 Aantoonbare Agile/Scrum ervaring; SAFe is een sterke pré.

 PSPO I en PSPO II certificering (aanvullende certificeringen zijn een pré).

 Ervaring binnen enterprise-organisaties, overheid of infra-omgevingen.

 Affiniteit met data-intensieve omgevingen en begrip van architectuur, integraties, migraties, security en compliance op hoofdlijnen.

 Afgeronde hbo-opleiding.

 Professionele beheersing van Nederlands en Engels.

 Voldoe je niet aan elk punt, maar wel nieuwsgierig? Dan komen we alsnog graag met je in contact.
 
 Wat je krijgt 
 Salaris tussen €6.000-€7.000 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis & ervaring) + 8% vakantiegeld.

 Jaarlijkse winstdeling en pensioenregeling.

 Hybride werken: op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, bij de klant of vanuit huis.

 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om tijdelijk vanuit het buitenland te werken.

 Elektrische leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding.

 Netto thuiswerkvergoeding, een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek en een laptop en telefoon, die je ook privé kunt gebruiken.

 Om de twee weken op vrijdag komen alle collega's terug naar ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, dan investeren wij tot 10% van jouw werktijd in kennisdeling, leren en verbinden (dit noemen wij de clubdag).

 Extra's zoals onbeperkt opleidingsbudget, dagelijkse verse lunch, jaarlijks wintersport en wellbeing-activiteiten, , zoals een wijnproeverij en yoga.

 
 Sollicitatieprocedure 
 We willen je leren kennen, en jij ons. Daarom houden we het persoonlijk en concreet.
 Kennismaking: Een eerste gesprek over wie je bent, wat je drijft en of er een match is.

 Verdiepende gesprekken: Twee gesprekken over je ervaring, werkwijze en hoe jij past binnen de squad en bij onze klanten.

 Aanbieding: Als het klikt, volgt een concreet aanbod.

 Vragen vooraf? Neem contact op met Siënna via 
 Over LINKIT 
 LINKIT is opgericht in 1998 en gegroeid van IT-bemiddelaar naar kennisgedreven IT-organisatie, met ruim 250 Explorers uit meer dan 25 nationaliteiten. We werken voor grote organisaties in overheid, finance en logistiek als partner die meedenkt van vraagstuk tot oplossing. 
 Als Senior Product Owner werk je op opdracht bij onze klanten, met een contract bij LINKIT. Je bepaalt je eigen richting, met een ongelimiteerd opleidingsbudget en de ruimte om te groeien op een manier die bij jou past.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Data & Platform (SaaS / Remote)
jobs.description:
Ready to own it, build it, and grow it? 
 
 The Mission: 
 Publitas turns retailers' static catalogs into interactive, shoppable digital experiences for brands across Europe and North America. We're a small, fully remote product organisation. 
 You'll be hands-on: in the codebase, in the data, prototyping with AI and shipping yourself. The default assumption is that you can figure it out, not that someone else will figure it out for you. 
 

 What you'll own 
 A product area with its own customers, roadmap and tech lead. You decide what gets built, in what order, and you carry the outcome. 

 Your first 90 days 
 Day 30 - You know your key stakeholders, have a baseline understanding of the product area and its challenges, and a working relationship with the team. You understand how the product is built and where the data lives well enough to form your own view, not one handed to you. A first version of the roadmap is on the table. 

 Day 60 - You've made your first major call - a scope cut, a kill, a bet - grounded in evidence and explicit about what would change your mind. You've found the gap between what was decided in your area and what actually ships, and closed at least one. You've put something real in front of customers or the team that you built yourself - a prototype, a working change - rather than waited for. 

 Day 90 - Your roadmap is trustworthy: Now, Next and Later are current and nobody has to ask what's happening. You've shipped your first prototype yourself, and your team is working AI-first. 

 
 
 What we need from you 
 Builder depth. You understand how software is built well enough to prototype against live services with AI tools, pull your own data, and ship without waiting for an engineer. 

 Evidence over summaries. You've made expensive go/no-go calls - a migration, a vendor choice, killing a product - from the evidence underneath, and you can explain what you decided, why, and what would have changed your mind. 

 Senior product experience. You've scaled a B2B product and know what that takes: the retention politics, the roadmap pressure from customer-facing teams, the trade-offs nobody wants to make. 

 Lived AI experience. You've shipped real work where AI did part of it and you can tell us exactly where it went wrong. You think in workflows and systems, not prompts. 

 Proactivity in an async team. You set priorities, make trade-offs, and decide what ships. 

 Excellent written English. We're fully remote and async-first; most of your influence travels in writing. 

 
 What We Offer You to Win 
 Compensation : Your salary is geo-bracketed to your location, with flexibility within the bracket based on your experience and what you bring to the role. A clear, performance-based path for progression follows from there.

 Real Ownership: Full autonomy over priorities, sequencing, and what ships within your pillars, plus the mandate to define how an entire product organization works with AI.

 True Remote Autonomy: No clock-watching or useless alignment meetings. You manage your territory as if it were your own business.

 Global Team Retreats: Working remotely shouldn't mean working isolated. We gather the entire company in inspiring cities across the globe once a year to connect, strategize, and celebrate in person.

 Modern Gear: A premium MacBook, remote work accessories, and a co-working budget if you want to work outside your home.

 Personal Growth Budget: A monthly wellness allowance, an education/course budget to sharpen your skills, and free access to Kindle and Audible books.

 Time Off: 25 days of paid vacation plus your local national holidays.

 
 At Publitas, we see AI as a core lever for performance, efficiency, and innovation. We expect all team members to actively use AI in their daily work to improve quality, speed, and output. 
 Depending on the role, this ranges from effectively using AI tools in day-to-day workflows to designing and scaling AI-driven systems. We are not looking for candidates who are "AI-curious"; we look for people who already use AI to do better work and can demonstrate tangible impact.

jobs.description:
We're an Amsterdam-based team of 100 (and counting), with 25+ nationalities and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our collective travel belts. What we have in common, beyond very well-worn passports, is this: We want to change the way people travel. That's exactly what we're doing, with the app that lets you plan, track, and relive every trip. Polarsteps has over 20 million users already. For us, this is just the beginning.
  
 Your expedition: Product & Growth
  
 This role is about the heartbeat of Polarsteps, the social layer that keeps travelers connected to the people who care about their journeys. You'll own the Social & Follower experience. Your users are followers & travelers; think about features that help travelers share what they're experiencing and help followers stay close from a distance. You are responsible for the engagement mechanics; think about how to make followers feel involved, not just informed, turning a passive audience into a real homefront community.
  
 While innovating on this engagement, you will also be owning one of the most important growth loops of our business: the social viral loop. Here you'll be working closely working together with other teams that use the share flow, while also closely collaborating with our Growth & Marketing team who are in contact with resources like our Polarsteps Pioneers .
  
 The social viral loop is one of Polarsteps' core growth engines, and it deserves both love (features that make sharing feel fun and effortless - like our route sharing feature ) and brains (the thinking to optimize the numbers behind it). This is a role for someone who gets excited about optimizing the % in a growth loop and, in parallel, wants to grow product strategy skills on an important part of the travel experience while delivering a great experience to users.
 
 Your itinerary
 What your journey at Polarsteps will look like day-to-day. 
 You will:
 Own the Social & Follower experience end-to-end, from sharing functionality and growth loops to follower engagement features, likes, comments, and trip interaction.

 Drive growth for key metrics: MAU, sharing rates, and social engagement, setting the bar and holding yourself to it.

 Design and run experiments to validate ideas fast. You won't guess when you can test.

 Work hand-in-hand with Growth & Marketing to align product initiatives with acquisition and retention goals, no silos, just shared wins.

 Translate messy, complex problems into small, testable stories, making outcomes clear for everyone on the team.

 Celebrate the small wins as much as the big ones. Incremental progress is still progress.

 
 The equipment in your backpack

jobs.description:
About Rivia 
 Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital.
 Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated.
 Over the past two years, European and US based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution.  Product Function Building: Set up light processes (PRDs, documentation, release process, prioritization) that the team actually follows.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

The Virtual Private Cloud team develops the core networking layer of Nebius AI Cloud.

We provide secure and isolated private networks, connectivity from cloud resources to internet and external networks, and networking services such as routing, security groups, load balancing and VPN connectivity.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive complex initiatives spanning VPC, adjacent cloud services, and infrastructure layers. These may include launching VPC in new regions, supporting new hardware generations, improving platform scalability and resilience, evolving service architecture, and delivering new customer-facing networking capabilities.

You will work closely with developers, engineering managers, technical leads and product managers of VPC and adjacent teams. You will turn broad product and technical objectives into executable programs, define outcomes and acceptance criteria, expose dependencies and trade-offs, facilitate timely decisions, and coordinate delivery through validation, rollout, and operational readiness.
 

Requirements

  1. 5+ years of experience in technical program management, technical project management, engineering management, or a senior technical role involving the delivery of complex cross-team initiatives.
  2. A strong technical background: you should be able to participate meaningfully in discussions about cloud networking and distributed systems, understand system boundaries and failure modes, and challenge assumptions without needing to be the primary architect.
  3. Practical knowledge of networking fundamentals such as IPv4 and IPv6 addressing, routing, network isolation, NAT, firewalls and load balancing. You should be comfortable learning and reasoning about the architecture of a production cloud-networking platform.
  4. Ability to communicate complex technical topics clearly, facilitate decisions, and produce concise, actionable documentation.
  5. Proven experience coordinating initiatives involving multiple engineering teams with different priorities and dependencies.
  6. Ability to structure ambiguous problems, identify critical paths, manage risks, and adapt plans as requirements change.
  7. A practical, outcome-oriented approach and the ability to drive progress without relying on formal authority.
 

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Experience building or operating public-cloud or other large-scale infrastructure.
  • Experience with VPCs, SDN, network virtualization, or Linux networking.
  • Experience leading programs focused on reliability, scalability, or operational improvement.
  • Experience designing lightweight planning, risk-management, or operational-readiness processes for engineering organizations.

jobs.title: Group Product Manager (m/w/d) / Team Lead Product
jobs.description:
Einleitung
 Bei Peter Park ist "Product" nicht einfach nur ein Unternehmensbereich. Hier trifft alles aufeinander: Wohin wir als Unternehmen wollen, was wir verkaufen, wie wir wachsen, was unsere Kunden erleben. Als Group Product Manager verantwortest du eine Product Area im Produktmanagement, führst ein Team von Product Managern und arbeitest täglich mit einem breiten Stakeholder-Feld zusammen. Wenn du wirklich gestalten und führen willst, ist das die richtige Stelle.
 Was ist Deine Aufgabe?
 People Leadership, Coaching & Culture: Du hast die volle disziplinarische Verantwortung für ein Team von 2–3 Product Managern und prägst die Teamkultur mit dem Ziel, wachsende Eigenverantwortung und Empowerment im Team zu entwickeln.

 Produktstrategie & Alignment: Du entwickelst und verantwortest die Strategie für deine Product Area und stellst das kontinuierliche Alignment mit unseren Unternehmenszielen sicher. Du managst den Produktlebenszyklus und pflegst den Product Governance Prozess – schnell liefern, ohne Qualität zu opfern.

 Business Impact & Markt: Du steuerst Ressourcen für maximalen Impact und bewertest und verbesserst kontinuierlich die Kundenzufriedenheit auf Area-Ebene. Dafür hast du Markttrends und den Wettbewerb stets im Blick.

 Stakeholder-Management: Du hältst für deine Product Area die Fäden zusammen und hast stets das große Ganze im Blick. Dabei kommunizierst du sicher mit unterschiedlichen Unternehmensbereichen und Managementebenen.

 Deine Fähigkeiten:
 Du bringst 7+ Jahre relevante Erfahrung als Senior PM, Lead PM oder Team Lead im Product Management mit – idealerweise in einem schnellwachsenden Start-up, Scale-up, SaaS- oder IoT-Umfeld.

 Du hast über 1,5 Jahre Erfahrung in der disziplinarischen Führung.

 Du hast eigenständig eine Produktstrategie auf Area-Ebene entwickelt und verantwortet – inkl. Roadmap-Planung.

 Du arbeitest sicher mit agilen Methoden und bist vertraut mit Outcome-Metriken und datenbasierter Entscheidungsfindung.

 Du verfügst über exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeiten für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen und eine ausgeprägte Fähigkeit zur internen Kollaboration.

 Du denkst unternehmerisch, übernimmst Ownership für komplexe Themen und verlierst dabei nie das große Ganze aus dem Blick.

 Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und verfügst über gute Englischkenntnisse.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager
jobs.description:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. 
 
 Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals .
 
 About the Role:
 We're hiring a Product Lead for two of our largest categories - established businesses that serve millions of customers and represent a significant share of company revenue. You will lead a dedicated cross-functional team, owning top-line business growth and a strategic roadmap to achieve results. You’ll own the end to end customer journey: how customers find us, the acquisition funnel, and their experience on treatment.
 The core of the job is disciplined, high-velocity experimentation. We’re looking for someone who is systematic about finding those opportunities, rigorous about testing them, and uses learnings to inform the roadmap.
 This role also sits inside a broader shift in how our product development organization works. We’ve rebuilt our operating model around AI, and are especially reinventing how AI can drive growth experimentation. This role sits at the center of that.
 
 You Will:
 Own growth targets, including new customer acquisition and retention

 Set the product strategy and roadmap for the team, sequencing work according to expected impact and making tradeoffs

 Build and run a continuous experimentation program with cross-functional partners: maintain a prioritized hypothesis backlog, keep multiple tests in flight, define success metrics and guardrails before launch, and hold a high bar on how results are interpreted

 Improve the end-to-end customer experience across acquisition surfaces, onboarding, checkout and pricing presentation, refills, and long-term subscription retention

 Communicate the state of the business to leadership and cross-functional partners on a regular cadence through clear written updates on metrics, experiments, and learnings

 
 You Have:
 5+ years of product management experience, including several years in a growth, funnel, or monetization role where you owned business metrics

 Deep fluency in experimentation and data

 An established practice of working with AI agents in your day-to-day product work, and a clear point of view on what that changes about how teams operate and what products should be

 Strong communication and a low-ego, high-EQ style. You build alignment, partner well across functions, and bring people with you.Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy in a fast-moving environment

 
 Our Benefits (there are more but here are some highlights): 
 Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles

 Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days

 Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave

 Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

 401k benefits with employer matching contribution

 Offsite team retreats

 Manage customer and sales expectations through well managed structured cadences

FUNCTION: Product

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Fiat product team and own the operational backbone of our fiat payment flows.

Every day, BVNK moves money for enterprise customers across SEPA, SWIFT, ACH, RTGS and instant payment schemes. Getting a payment out of the door is only half the job. What happens next (a return, a recall, a rejected payment, a compliance hold, an investigation or a customer query) is where trust is won or lost. Your mission is to make those processes fast, reliable, automated and compliant, at scale.

You'll own the product strategy for the post-initiation and exception lifecycle of fiat payments: returns, recalls, rejections, repairs, investigations, compliance-driven holds and releases, and the tooling our operations teams use to manage them. You'll work hand in hand with payment operations, compliance, financial crime, treasury, finance and our banking partners to turn manual processes into well-designed product capabilities.

You'll partner with senior product managers, engineers and architects and with small, autonomous engineering squads, and you'll take products from discovery and design all the way through to launch. We see AI as a key lever in how we build and operate, and we expect you to use it in your day-to-day work.

Key Areas of Responsibilities:

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for FIAT payment operations, covering the full exception lifecycle of payment flows across all schemes we support: SEPA (SCT and SCT Inst), SWIFT, ACH, Fedwire, FedNow, RTP and Faster Payments.
